title: Klaipėda Lighthouse
visualBrief: Black and white banded stair cylinder rising from a broad older plinth and stepped folded-metal collar; molded rounded capital beneath a square iron gallery, narrow shaft windows, arched entry, orange partly enclosed lantern, circular roof guard, optic-side glazing and published gallery hardware.

sourceFacts.basis: LTSA repair announcement supplies 40m structural height. The city tourism page identifies the 44m value as elevation above sea level. Exact-QID OSM footprint fixes the broad base. Public library contemporary photos and historic aerial control the separate plinth/collar, square gallery, rounded capital and orange lantern; minor dimensions are reconstructed from their proportions.

geographicProposal.notes: Exact-QID base center corrects the catalog coordinate approximately58m southwest. Entry faces the southeastern/eastern station forecourt, reconstructed from the public-library aerial and present mapped service court. Square gallery and the seaward glazed lantern share this station axis; facade angle is a photographed quadrant, not a survey bearing.

limitations: Retained40m structural height and mapped broad-base footprint;44m is focal elevation above sea level. Intermediate component sizes, entrance quadrant and gallery/lantern facing remain photo-based reconstructions rather than surveyed controls.

Host terrain contact isY0 at the broad base. Adjacent station buildings, vegetation, temporary flags/site-spanning cables and native local terrain clearance remain outside this individual tower review. Current paint/equipment can change; no optical-sector navigation certification.

Detailed masters remain intact. Skyline uses opaque glazing and omits tiny lamp/hardware details; near levels restore the compact visible optic and hardware. District stripe width/curves, guards, roundels, seams and optical fins aggregate. Physical-device timings remain pending.
referenceRights: Original geometry and shared procedural materials. Official photographs are research references only; no reference imagery or third-party mesh is embedded or redistributed.

nativeAxes.origin: Authored main tower center at local base level; attached ensembles are offset from this origin.

appearance.identity: 40m black/white daymark lighthouse: broad historic base with arched entry, two stepped metal shoulders, ten bands and a seaward vertical stripe, rounded capital, square iron gallery, partly enclosed orange lantern, roof guard and finial. Near views retain compact optic, dish, paired aerials and gallery lights.
appearance.master: Preserve the57618triangle detailed source/imported master unchanged.
appearance.browser: Four complete source-local levels retain the whole base, shoulders, daymark, capital, square gallery, orange lantern and40m tip. Skyline has a real arched entry, exact stripe boundaries and opaque average glazing. District retains the true door/window recesses, compact optic and all major hardware, with sparse seams/guards and coarse roundels; street restores more guard/seam/optic detail; closeup restores finer curves and seams. Shared256px mineral, painted-metal and wood graphs are reused. Tiny source fittings aggregate with distance.

geometrySource: Original component-authored exterior mesh using cited dimensional evidence and separately described photo/map reconstructions. No downloaded mesh, texture or reference image is embedded.
